vera_pocket_public.notes: Approved Vesper public voice using Pocket TTS built-in Vera. Synthesis is rendering only and creates no send, identity, translation, spend, fulfilment, or release authority.

piper_free_local_baseline.notes: Official Piper baseline voice for local experiment only. It is not claimed to be South African and is not the final Vesper voice.

openvoice2_sa_warm_candidate.accent_claim: South African English only after reviewed reference evidence exists
openvoice2_sa_warm_candidate.notes: Candidate extracted from the VAMP OpenVoice2 architecture. Requires a reviewed, consented Vesper reference embedding before any public voice claim.

openvoice2_sa_executive_candidate.accent_claim: South African English only after reviewed reference evidence exists
openvoice2_sa_executive_candidate.notes: Executive delivery candidate using the same Vesper identity architecture with a different approved reference/style target.

piper_sa_english_candidate.accent_claim: South African English only after reviewed voice evidence exists
piper_sa_english_candidate.notes: Reserved for a reviewed South African English Piper model or a locally trained voice with clear licensing and consent provenance.

unsupported_language_policy: LINGUA may render reviewed text, but Vesper must not claim a native spoken voice for a language until an approved voice model and pronunciation review exist.
